claims: Tyson Fury defeated Arslanbek Makhmudov on April 11, 2026
Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov took place at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London
Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov topped a 10-fight card
The 10-fight card's main card was streamed on Netflix
Conor Benn defeated Regis Prograis
Richard Riakporhe won his fight
Justis Huni won his fight
Tyson Fury vs. Arslanbek Makhmudov was the main event in heavyweight
Conor Benn vs. Regis Prograis was the co-main event at catchweight 150 lbs
Richard Riakporhe vs. Jeamie Tshikeva was in heavyweight
Justis Huni vs. Frazer Clarke was in heavyweight
Felix Cash vs. Liam O'Hare was in middleweight
Troy Williamson vs. Simon Zachenhuber was in super middleweight
Breyon Gorham vs. Eduard Georgiev was in junior welterweight
Mikie Tallon vs. Cristopher Rios was in flyweight
Elliot Whale vs. Tom Hill was in welterweight
Hector Lozano vs. Sultan Almohammed was in lightweight
Prelims and undercard were streamed on Tudum and Ring Magazine social channels
Tyson Fury won by decision with scores of 120-108, 120-108, 119-109
Tyson Fury's win was in his return to the ring
